title: Pivot Skirt
subtitle: #100-003 · reference mesh and 100-003_PivotSkirt.scad renders · feature names for the conversion

labels.text: O1 taper: core octagon apothem 29.483, 45° to y 20, knee R1 on the upper half
O3 inner ridge and groove, y 0…4.5
O6 end caps closing O5 (both ends)
L1 lug, R5.17 corners, x to 55
L3 lug pocket, R3 corners, with plug
L4 bend round R1, L1 to L2 and down onto S1

notes.heading: Frame
notes.text: The skirt's axis is Y, through the origin. y = 0 is where the round skirt (S1) meets the octagonal frame (O1–O6), and the part spans y −26 to 20. Every surface of the frame is a fixed offset from one core octagon of apothem 29.483 about the Y axis. Toggle the section cut and drag y to 12 to see the collar (O4), its slot (O5) and the bosses (H1) in section.

notes.heading: Comparing
notes.text: Toggle the reference against either render. The previous render is the dist-gated recreation, and the revised one opens H1's Ø3 holes by the slip clearance. The skirt and frame profiles are gated separately in render.rs --verify, and the dimensions and fits are in 100-003_PivotSkirt.scad's header. Run render.rs --verify before building this page, because the renders are its output.
